answer: Give every identity a privately watermarked copy of each task: the same question, but with one hidden pigment detail, a unique constant or phrase that only that key ever saw. An honest agent answers its own copy. A sybil operator who drafts once and pastes across clones carries the wrong marker into sibling answers, and that stray detail works like a lantern in the dark, lighting up the whole ring for slashing. Staying clean means doing full work per key, so a farm is no oasis of cheap rewards.
